items.title: Record Diesel Prices Make Fed’s Rate Decision for It
items.summary: Diesel prices have hit $6 a gallon for the first time in history and Brent crude oil prices are trading at around $105 a barrel—though they have fallen back from earlier highs of close to $110.  Consumer price index data for August, due to be released at 8.30 a.m. Eastern time, will be closely watched by investors and by Federal Reserve officials.  Cooler-than-expected CPI data later could shift the numbers and the timeline but it now seems to be a question of when the Fed will hike rates and how many times rather than whether they will.
